name: claudinator
description: Give Claude Code a glow-up: six switchable looks and nine mixable ingredients for tool calls, the working line and turn receipts, plus panes to navigate long sessions. Draws locally, makes no network requests.

look.title: Look
look.description: The look Claudinator starts with. Your choice in the /claudinator picker takes precedence.

attentionSound.title: Sound when Claude needs you
attentionSound.description: After two minutes waiting on a permission prompt, play a short system sound (pw-play, paplay or afplay). Off by default.

attentionNotify.title: Desktop notification when Claude needs you
attentionNotify.description: After two minutes waiting on a permission prompt, send a desktop notification (notify-send or osascript). Off by default.
